input.title: Give the colour filter select an accessible name
input.rationale: The <select id="g-filter"> has no accessible name. The visible <label>Filter by colour</label> right before it isn't linked to it, because it has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the select. I can only edit the select itself, so I'm adding aria-label="Filter by colour". It uses the same words as the visible label, so screen-reader and voice-control users hear the same name that sighted users see. A better follow-up fix in the source would be to add for="g-filter" to the existing <label>. That fixes the link and also lets users click the label to focus the select. If you do that, you can remove the aria-label. Please re-test after applying this. It fixes the reported issue but doesn't guarantee the page is compliant.
